quantize_TorchAoQuantize_convert: quantize a transformer model layer using TorchAoQuantize.convert with a tensor input dict and full layer name
deserialize_TorchAoDeserialize_convert: deserialize torchao safetensors quantized weights by reconstructing tensor subclass instances from unflattened state dicts
run_quantize_with_cpu_offload: run quantization on CPU-offloaded modules by temporarily moving them to CUDA before quantizing then moving back to CPU
untie_embedding_weights: untie embedding weights during quantization by setting tie_word_embeddings to False when untie_embedding_weights is enabled
add_linear_extra_repr: add custom extra_repr to quantized linear modules showing in_features, out_features, and quantized weight type
